latest.title: The Diamond Model of Intrusion Analysis in AWS
latest.description: Explore the Diamond Model of Intrusion Analysis and how it can be applied to AWS security. Learn how Adversary, Capability, Infrastructure, and Victim connect to help security teams understand attacks and investigate threats. See how AWS services such as Amazon GuardDuty, AWS CloudTrail, Amazon Detective, IAM, Amazon Macie, and AWS Security Hub provide valuable visibility for detecting suspicious activity, analyzing incidents, and strengthening cloud security.

latest.title: Lesser Known AWS Features — Day 16: AWS Systems Manager Automation
latest.description: Day 16 of my AWS learning journey: Today I explored AWS Systems Manager Automation, and this was one of those features I didn't know much about before.

latest.title: Waterlog Watch: AI-verified flood alerts on AWS
latest.description: Turning monsoon photos into a live, AI-verified flood map and route checker with Lambda, DynamoDB, Amazon Location Service and Bedrock.

latest.title: From AI Ideas to Real-World Solutions with AWS
latest.description: Discover how AWS can help turn AI concepts into practical, scalable solutions for real-world challenges.

latest.title: AWS IAM: Understanding Identity, Roles, Policies, and Least-Privilege Security
latest.description:
When developers start working with AWS, they quickly encounter a common question:

Who is allowed to access this AWS resource?

Can a Lambda function read from an S3 bucket?
Can an EC2 instance access DynamoDB?
Can one AWS account access another account?
Can a developer deploy resources but not delete production infrastructure?

These questions are handled primarily through AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM).

latest.title: AWS in Disaster Management: How Cloud Computing Can Help During Emergencies
latest.description: From floods and earthquakes to large-scale emergencies, disaster response requires fast access to information and reliable communication. This article explores how AWS cloud technologies can support emergency data management, communication, monitoring, and decision-making.

latest.title: What is Bedrock Managed Agent (powered by OpenAI)?
latest.description: Amazon Bedrock Managed Agents powered by OpenAI combines the reasoning capabilities of OpenAI models with AWS-managed agent infrastructure. Instead of building a traditional application where every step of an investigation has to be explicitly coded, a managed agent can understand an objective, reason through the problem, select the appropriate tools and skills, execute those tools, evaluate the results, and continue the investigation until it has enough evidence to provide an answer.

latest.title: Building an AI-Powered Application on AWS: From Data to Intelligent Predictions
latest.description: Artificial intelligence is becoming part of everyday applications. This article explores how AWS services can be combined to build an AI-powered application, from collecting data to deploying a machine learning model and generating predictions.

latest.title: AWS Free Tier: How Beginners Can Learn Cloud Without Unexpected Bills
latest.description: Starting AWS as a beginner can be exciting, but understanding cloud costs is just as important as learning cloud services. Here are some practical habits I’m using to learn AWS responsibly and avoid unexpected charges.

latest.title: Building a Highly Available Amazon EKS Cluster with Terraform: A Step-by-Step Guide
latest.description: Learn how to provision an Amazon EKS environment using Terraform, including the VPC, public and private subnets, IAM roles, managed node groups, and Kubernetes workloads. This hands-on guide also covers deployment validation, high availability, and application rollback.

trending.title: Strands Box on AWS Lambda MicroVMs: a kernel per agent, a policy per command, and a fleet to run them with microvm-ctl
trending.description: Strands Box checks every shell command, file and request an agent makes against a Dogwood policy. Lambda MicroVMs give the agent its own kernel. I built Box for aarch64 Linux, ran it inside Lambda MicroVMs, and drove fleets with microvm-ctl: 83 ms per box, 22.7 boxes/s per 1 GB VM, 64 of 64 correct across 8 VMs, a playground app, and the bugs I hit.

trending.title: A Physical AI Robot Episode Judge That Knows When It Does Not Know: Strands Decider in Strands Robots
trending.description: I added Strands Decider as an opt-in episode-judge backend in strands-labs/robots. It labels a recorded robot episode with one HTTP request (about 1.8 s), returns calibrated probabilities, and writes a label only when it is confident. On a 12-episode MuJoCo test it wrote zero wrong labels and left every unsure episode, with its probabilities, for the existing VLM judge.

trending.title: Introducing Events on AWS Builder Center
trending.description: Starting today, builders can find and register for events hosted by AWS Heroes, Community Builders, User Group Leaders, and Student Builder Group Leaders on Builder Center, and get reminders and updates as push notifications in the AWS Builder app.

trending.title: La Gran Mentira de los Contenedores: Por Qué un Contenedor Docker NO Es una Máquina Virtual Ligera
trending.description: Si has trabajado en desarrollo de software o infraestructura en los últimos cinco años, probablemente has escuchado la analogía clásica para explicar Docker: "Un contenedor es simplemente como una máquina virtual, pero más ligera y rápida".

trending.title: How I Trained the Best 2B Strands Decider: Beating the Official Strands Model and the 2B Leaders, Top 3 in Text, Image and Multimodal
trending.description: I unlocked image input in Strands Decider, then trained four 2B-class checkpoints that beat the published v19 and, by my estimate, take the top 3 spots on the 2B text board, #2 on images and the best text+image slot. This is the full engineering story: the benchmark rules, a 27B yes/no teacher, a base-model bake-off, a calibration fix, a text+image model that broke and was repaired, and an unseen-task check against the 2B leaders. All scores are local and unofficial.
